name: Royal Enfield — Comprehensive End-to-End Frontend Experience Verification
description: Full frontend verification of the Royal Enfield web application at http://localhost:5173/. Tests homepage load, fixed navigation, hero 3D carousel controls and auto-rotation, GLTF 3D motorcycle model rendering, parts archive cards and modal, motorcycle collection display, test ride booking interface, contact form validation, responsiveness, and clean browser console.

planSteps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:5173/ and wait for the page to finish initial loading
The page title contains 'Royal Enfield', the primary logo is rendered, and the main heading 'ROYAL ENFIELD' is visible in the hero section
The hero motorcycle carousel headline displays the active model name matching the selected bottom indicator pill
Click the next arrow button (aria-label 'Next motorcycle') in the hero carousel
The active motorcycle headline updates to the next model and the active pill indicator advances
Click the previous arrow button (aria-label 'Previous motorcycle')
The hero carousel rotates back to display the previous motorcycle title and matching indicator
Wait for 2 to 3 seconds without clicking any hero controls
The automatic rotation advances the turntable and updates the active motorcycle name in the headline
Scroll down past 80px to activate the top fixed navigation bar and click the '3D EXPERIENCE' link
The page smoothly scrolls down to the 3D Experience section '#bike-3d' displaying heading 'THE MACHINE, UP CLOSE.', and the '01 ENGINE' hotspot button ('#hotspot-btn-engine') is visible and enabled
The WebGL Three.js canvas container renders the GLTF motorcycle model and the loading spinner clears without fatal error
Click the '01 ENGINE' hotspot button (aria-label 'Focus J-SERIES 349 CC', id '#hotspot-btn-engine')
The component details panel appears displaying 'J-SERIES 349 CC' and engine specifications
Scroll down to the Parts Archive section '#parts-archive'
Component cards for J-Series Engine, Tuned Peashooter, Signature Headlight, Teardrop Reservoir, and Contoured Saddle are displayed with transparent images and stat lines
Click the 'VIEW DETAIL' button on the J-Series Engine card
A modal dialog appears displaying comprehensive engineering details for the J-Series Engine
Close the parts details modal dialog
The modal closes and the Parts Archive section remains visible
Scroll down to the Collection section '#choose-your-ride'
The section heading 'CHOOSE YOUR RIDE.' and motorcycle selector tabs 01 through 06 are rendered
Click the tab for '05 HIMALAYAN 450'
The motorcycle display updates with the Himalayan 450 image, 'HIMALAYAN 450' title, and updated specifications grid
Click the 'BOOK A TEST RIDE' button
The test ride booking modal dialog opens with fields for Full Name, Phone, Email, Dealership City, and Date
Attempt to submit the booking form without entering a name
HTML5 form validation prevents submission and requests completion of the required fields
Enter 'Jane Doe' in Full Name, '+91 9876543210' in Phone, 'jane.doe@example.com' in Email, and click 'CONFIRM TEST RIDE'
The booking modal transitions to the 'TEST RIDE CONFIRMED' screen displaying the rider summary
Click 'RETURN TO SHOWROOM'
The booking modal closes
Scroll down to the Contact section '#contact'
The Contact section renders authorized branch cards and the direct inquiry form with name, email, and message inputs
Attempt to submit the direct inquiry form while fields are empty
HTML5 validation prevents submission of the empty form
Fill in name with 'Rider One', email with 'rider@example.com', message with 'Booking inquiry', and click 'SEND MESSAGE'
The contact form transitions to the confirmation screen displaying 'MESSAGE RECEIVED'
All sections adapt cleanly across viewports without horizontal page overflow
The browser console log has zero unhandled exceptions or fatal JavaScript runtime errors
